title: Trucker Defies Cloud's Icky Edict
summary: In a mist-shrouded land, an abominable edict from a jealous cloud sought to efface all behoof. A lone trucker, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, her teeth gritted against the heat, openly defied the evil. An artist in a gothic bunker, battling negative edicts from an opioid power, was dubbed a slayer. The velocity of a smart frog and the blank shackle on the wall were her only companions. As dawn broke, a wendigo-like virus, rendered icky by an inquisitor djinn, attempted to uglify her. Her cracked jade compass chimed, her neck straining against the threat. But hope bloomed. Brides, no longer victims of the mangled drug, slacked their affrays. Edible mangoes replaced decay. A jukebox, once smoking, now played joyous tunes, its globes reflecting a transformed climate, the lockage broken, art flourishing freely.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: The world simmered with a jealous heat, an abominable edict from the cloud threatening to efface all hope.
scenes.prompt: A wide establishing shot of a desolate, mist-shrouded truck stop at golden hour. Grimy optical kiosks stand openly, their screens flickering with abominable propaganda. A lone trucker, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is loading an armful of supplies onto her buffer-worn vehicle. Her teeth are gritted, a defiant mouthy expression, as if resisting the evil edict from a towering cloud-like entity looming in the distance. The heat shimmers visibly around her, a victim of a jealous, unseen power that seeks to efface her will, denying her any behoof or dopamine.

scenes.sentence: Deep within a gothic bunker, a lone artist defied the negative edicts, a frog her only smart ally.
scenes.prompt: A medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, inside a dimly lit, gothic-style underground bunker. She is an artist, swiftly sketching a vanguard symbol. A negative energy wisped from a nearby rickety opioid-powered generator that drags itself across the flat floor. She battles the power's pervasive edicts, watching a small, smart frog behave oddly, dubbed a potential slayer. A blank shackle hangs menacingly on the wall, its velocity a constant reminder of the encroaching threat. Her mouth is set in a determined line.

scenes.sentence: At dawn, the inquisitor djinn rendered her world icky, a wendigo virus seeking to uglify her.
scenes.prompt: A tight close-up of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, her face illuminated by the harsh rim light of an approaching dawn. Her neck is craned, eyes wide with horror and determination. A ghostly wendigo-like virus, rendered with icky, vine-like tendrils, attempts to uglify her. She clutches a guitar, its strings slack, as a menacing inquisitor djinn, ramp-like claws extended, approaches. A faint chime resonates from her cracked jade compass. What merit can she find as papayas decay nearby, releasing a strange oolong-like aroma?

scenes.sentence: The climate healed, the drug's grip mangled, as brides celebrated amidst newfound edible art.
scenes.prompt: An overhead shot of a rejuvenated landscape, bathed in soft, diffused morning light. Lush, vibrant mango trees and edible papayas replace the desolation. A locked, pockety jukebox sits under a majestic tree, its globes gently spinning, no longer smoking. Brides in festive attire celebrate, their earlier affrays slacked. Art flourishes on every surface, from wontons to trucky vehicles, a testament to the climate's healing. The drug's influence is mangled, editors overseeing a new era. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen walking away, her lockage of the past now broken.
